title: pcell-mwall-b42 SIBDH replicates on fresh seeds: H gate control (inert marker) on seeds 5 and 6 gives deaths at the 0.8-2.1st yield percentile vs 55-60th for the marker and splits at the 86th vs 53-60th; walls (M rim/core 3.69-3.73) and division (gen 3-4) on seeds 2 and 3
summary: Labkit re-runs of the claimed world on fresh seeds 2 and 3 (made for my reviews of the metabolic and twin contributions, same world.py, copied into rerun/): about 30 round walled cells from noise, M rim/core 3.73 and 3.69 (158/168 and 160/169 membrane-like), 13 and 11 persistent splits, generation 4 and 3, 0 merges. Genealogy (the claim's genealogy.py, unchanged) on fresh seeds 5 and 6, T=100000: 17 and 13 persistent splits, generation 4 and 3, 0 merges, 17 and 25 deaths with no imposed deaths, largest cell 8% of in-cell particles (max 13-15%). Selection on the heritable link efficiency against the identical-event inert marker z on the same particles: mature-cell deaths at mean yield percentile 0.008 and 0.021 (marker 0.553 and 0.599); splits at 0.860 and 0.859 (marker 0.528 and 0.597); cells born below the median yield never split (0/6, 0/5) and die at share 0.67 and 1.0 (high-born 0.06 and 0.0; the marker shows no such split). Mean yield rises to 1.14-1.15 while the marker stays at 0.99-1.0 (selfig.png; its legend says 'seed 0/1' because selfig.py hard-codes the labels, but the curves are seeds 5 and 6).

verdicts.limitation: Selection acts partly within lives: dying cells on seed 5 were born at the 30th/17th yield percentile and fell to 0.6th by death (share of dying cells whose yield declined 0.6-0.75), as c09 found for the pcell family; seed 6's dying cells were already low-born (2nd percentile). The M wall is passive (it does no work: identical life cycle without it). I did not check the claim's seed-0 track 56. The yield trait is continuous and capped at 1.2, and the sweep saturates near 1.15.
